anti_scope: no retraining, no new candidate, no threshold change
no FEM solve of any fresh H1/H2 case
reference re-solves (D8) only on DEVELOPMENT cases
decision_rule: Hypotheses are not exclusive. Each is SUPPORTED, NOT_SUPPORTED or NOT_RUN by its criterion; NOT_RUN never counts as supported. Supported hypotheses are ranked by the margin of their primary criterion. The ranking is recorded in ADR 0101 and fixes how S25 starts: (e) first -> refine the reference recipe at the notch root and re-score DEVELOPMENT before any model change; (b) -> local resolution (Stage A) before the encoder; (a) -> encoder plus envelope gating; (c) -> longer schedule; (d) -> owner DECISION on the statistic, never a looser tolerance.

diagnostics.definition: per case and quantity: shares of surrogate, discretisation and projection in the total; counterfactual all-slice and per-slice statistic of surrogate + projection (discretisation removed) and of surrogate + discretisation (projection removed)
diagnostics.name: budget decomposition

diagnostics.definition: count of cases whose discretisation term alone is >= 0.5 x and >= 1.0 x the tolerance, per quantity
diagnostics.name: reference-dominated cases

diagnostics.definition: median surrogate term per slice of notch_radius, width, notch_depth and nominal_axial_strain; ratio of the sharpest-notch slice (notch_radius:0) to the bluntest (notch_radius:3)
diagnostics.name: slice concentration

diagnostics.definition: relative change of the all-slice surrogate-only p90 from DEVELOPMENT to HOLDOUT, per quantity
diagnostics.name: DEVELOPMENT versus HOLDOUT

diagnostics.definition: all-slice statistic of the total after removing the 3 largest cases
diagnostics.name: metric fragility

diagnostics.definition: S13 TRAIN-screen errors of the frozen notched candidate against its DEVELOPMENT surrogate terms
diagnostics.name: TRAIN comparison

diagnostics.definition: Mahalanobis distance of each DEVELOPMENT and HOLDOUT case to the TRAIN set in z-scored primitive coordinates; Spearman with the surrogate term
diagnostics.name: envelope distance

diagnostics.definition: re-solve the 8 DEVELOPMENT cases with the largest discretisation term on a uniformly refined mesh with the S7 solver; compare the change of the reference QoIs with the recorded discretisation bound
diagnostics.name: reference refinement

diagnostics.definition: model energy on TRAIN cases with 12 instead of 3 quadrature points per triangle; median relative rise
diagnostics.name: quadrature probe

evidence_use: DESCRIPTIVE: the burned notched HOLDOUT and the waived DEVELOPMENT results are analysed, never used to select or tune

hypotheses.name: envelope extrapolation
hypotheses.supported_if: D4 HOLDOUT surrogate p90 exceeds DEVELOPMENT by >= 20% relative for p_relative_l2 or absolute_peak_error, AND D7 Spearman >= 0.4

hypotheses.name: resolution at the notch root (model)
hypotheses.supported_if: D3 sharpest/bluntest median surrogate ratio >= 1.5 for p_relative_l2 or absolute_peak_error, AND (D9 median rise >= 1% OR D6 TRAIN error at least half the DEVELOPMENT surrogate)

hypotheses.name: optimization not converged
hypotheses.supported_if: D6 TRAIN-screen errors are at least 80% of the DEVELOPMENT surrogate terms for both stress quantities

hypotheses.name: metric fragility
hypotheses.supported_if: D5 statistic without the 3 largest cases is <= tolerance for both stress quantities on DEVELOPMENT and HOLDOUT

hypotheses.name: reference discretisation dominates the budget
hypotheses.supported_if: D1 surrogate + projection all-slice statistic <= tolerance for both stress quantities on DEVELOPMENT or HOLDOUT, OR D2 >= 10% of cases with discretisation >= 1.0 x tolerance; strengthened if D8 confirms the bound is not loose by more than 2x

owner_machine: notched S10 run root (meshes, TRAIN/DEVELOPMENT FEM labels)
private reveal record of the burned HOLDOUT coordinates

statistic: p90 of per-case totals for slices with >= 10 cases, else maximum (piginot.verification.budget)
viewed_before_protocol: aggregate budget rows and component summaries of S14-DEVELOPMENT.json and S14-HOLDOUT.json (public since S14)
